rules.rule: moving workloads whose dependencies lead back to themselves
an id in the dependencies of a workload that no record of the inventory has
a record whose id an earlier record already has
a workload with an empty owner, or an inventory with no owner column
a workload with an empty migration path, or an inventory with no path column
a migration path that is none of retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform, refactor and the 7 aliases of the configuration
a workload with the path retire that a workload with another path depends on
a workload with the path retain that a workload that moves depends on
a move group with more workloads than the largest wave size of 3
a record of the inventory with no id, the wrong number of fields or a value of the wrong kind
an inventory that the tool could not read as UTF-8 text
an inventory that the CSV or JSON reader refuses, or whose header or shape is not that of an inventory

basis.text: the guide names seven migration strategies, the 7 Rs: retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform, and refactor or re-architect
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)

basis.text: rehost, also called lift and shift, moves an application to the cloud without changing it
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)

basis.text: relocate moves many servers at once to a cloud version of the same platform, or moves resources to another network, Region or account, without changing the architecture
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)

basis.text: repurchase, also called drop and shop, replaces an application with another version or product, often one sold as a service
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)

basis.text: replatform, also called lift, tinker and shift or lift and reshape, moves an application and makes some changes on the way, such as a managed database
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)

basis.text: refactor or re-architect changes the architecture of an application to use cloud-native features; it is the most complex strategy, and the guide advises against it for large migrations
basis.source: About the migration strategies (AWS Prescriptive Guidance, Guide for AWS large migrations)
